  PROBLEM: The last run diff claims to have extended the fragment from 2 to 6 lines (the diffstat shows "4 insertions(+), 7 deletions(-)"), but the file on disk still contains only the `<!-- changelog: security -->` marker and the headline sentence.
  WHY IT FAILS AT RUNTIME: When `scripts/assemble_changelog.py` folds this fragment into `CHANGELOG.md` at release time, the entry has no lead paragraph (describing what changed for users/operators) and no "What this means for operators" closing paragraph, violating CLAUDE.md §20.D's mandatory structure.
- tests/test_review_autofix_claude_fixer_mode.py:lines 33-39 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The duplicate `from test_review_autofix_merge_precheck import (test_...)` block is still present at lines 33-39 of the file, despite the last autofix run's commit (`dda0cc6`) claiming to remove it (the diffstat shows "7 deletions(-)" for this file).
  WHY IT FAILS AT RUNTIME: Because `ci.yml:866` now runs `tests/test_review_autofix_merge_precheck.py` directly as its own pytest invocation AND the test-collector later traverses `tests/test_review_autofix_claude_fixer_mode.py` which re-imports those four `test_*` names, pytest collects each test twice. Each duplicate collection re-runs the expensive temporary-Git-repo setup in `test_dispatch_checkout_file_read_uses_head_not_default_branch` and the live checkout-step bash execution in `test_review_branch_fetch_movement_skips_the_older_source_tree`, materially inflating CI time and producing duplicate-test-id warnings.
